title: adenostemma fastigiatum
intro: Adenostemma fastigiatum, commonly known as "Makabuhay" or "Life Plant", is a medicinal herb native to the tropical regions of the Philippines and other parts of Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and serve as a natural antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Adenostemma fastigiatum include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
